[[Thomas Cook & Son]] (1881-2001) | website = {{URL|https://www.thomascook.in/}} }} '''Thomas Cook (India) Ltd'''. is an [[India|Indian]] travel agency, headquartered in [[Mumbai]], [[India]], providing [[travel services]] including [[Foreign exchange company|Foreign Exchange]], International and Domestic Holidays, [[Travel visa|Visas]], Passports, Travel Insurance and [[MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) tourism|MICE]]. Founded in 1881 by [[Thomas Cook]], the founder of the now defunct British brand [[Thomas Cook & Son]], who established its first office in India and eventually extended to over 233 locations, in 94 cities across [[India]], [[Sri Lanka]] and [[Mauritius]].[http://vedding.in/business/transportation/thomas-cook-travel-agency-in-/5636fa0a711fa "Thomas Cook Travel Agency Locations"] ''Vedding'' Thomas Cook India is a subsidiary of [[Fairfax Financial|Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited]], through its wholly owned subsidiary, Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Limited, and its controlled affiliates which holds 67.63% of the company.{{cite web |title=Thomas Cook India About Us |url=https://www.thomascook.in/about-us |website=Thomas Cook India |accessdate=9 September 2019}} == History == Thomas Cook had many ventures including the invention of the world's package tour in 1841, the first pre-paid hotel coupon in 1868, creation of the first holiday brochure in 1858, and conceptualization of the first Travellers Cheques in 1874.[http://www.pravdareport.com/society/stories/03-01-2013/123373-thomas_cook-0/ "Thomas Cook - The Founder of Mass Tourism"] ''Pravda Report'' In 1881, Thomas Cook started its India operations in [[Bombay]] (later renamed [[Mumbai]]), and in October 1978, saw it christened Thomas Cook (India) Ltd. The company made its first public issue in February 1983, and commenced operations in [[Mauritius]] in 2000. In the same year, they acquired the [[Sri Lanka]] business from Thomas Cook Overseas Ltd, UK.[http://www.business-standard.com/company/thomas-cook-i-564/information/company-history "Thomas Cook History"] ''Business Standard'' In 2006, Thomas Cook India Limited acquired LKP Forex Limited and Travel Corporation (India) Pvt. Ltd. (TCI). In May 2012, Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Limited acquired Thomas Cook India, and became a part of Fairfax Group, Canada.[http://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/thomas-cook-india-grows-through-acquisitions/article7519154.ece "Thomas Cook India Grows through Acquisitions"] ''The Hindu'', 11 August 2015 In 2013, Thomas Cook India Limited acquired [[Quess Corp]] (formerly known as Ikya Group - HR, IT Services, Facilities Management, Food Services, Skill Development),[http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Thomas-Cook-India-arm-Quess-Corp-to-acquire-49-stake-in-TSQ/articleshow/47500990.cms "Thomas Cook India Arm Quess Corp to Acquire 49% Stake"] ''Times of India'', 1 June 2015 and [[Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited|Sterling Holiday Resorts]].[http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/bombay-hc-approves-thomas-cook-india-sterling-holiday-merger-115071400243_1.html "Mumbai HC Approves TCIL and Sterling Holiday Resorts Merger"] ''Business Standard'', 14 July 2015 In 2015, Thomas Cook Lanka Pvt. Ltd. (a subsidiary of Thomas Cook India Limited) acquired Luxe Asia Pvt. Ltd., Sri Lanka,[http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/thomas-cook-india-acquires-sri-lanka-based-luxe-asia_2246641.html "Thomas Cook India Acquires Luxe Asia"] ''Money Control'' a regional Destination Management Company handling inbound tourists from globally generating markets to its destinations. In the same year, TCIL announced the acquisition of Kuoni Travel (India) Private Limited, a travel operator in India, and Kuoni Travel (China) Limited, a travel operator in Hong Kong.[http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/thomas-cook-buys-kuoni-india-for-rs-535-crore-115080701548_1.html "Thomas Cook Acquires Kuoni India"] ''Business Standard'', 8 August 2015 In September 2017, Thomas Cook acquired [[Tata Capital]]'s forex and travel business.{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/with-tata-capitals-travel-forex-biz-in-the-kitty-thomas-cook-eyes-100-m-in-extra-volumes/article9957052.ece|title=With Tata Capital's travel, forex biz in the kitty, Thomas Cook eyes $100 m in extra volumes|work=@businessline|access-date=2018-05-14|language=en}} In the aftermath of the collapse of [[Thomas Cook Group|Thomas Cook]] in the UK, the Indian namesake was considering rebranding itself to avoid the negative perception caused by the collapse of the UK travel company.{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/thomas-cook-collapses-thomas-cook-india-name-change-1602509-2019-09-24|title=Thomas Cook collapse: To avoid links with UK namesake, Indian unit may change its name|newspaper=India Today|language=en|access-date=2019-09-25|agency=Ist}} {| class="wikitable" |- ! extract: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd. is an Indian travel agency, headquartered in Mumbai, India, providing travel services including Foreign Exchange, International and Domestic Holidays, Visas, Passports, Travel Insurance and MICE. Founded in 1881 by Thomas Cook, the founder of the now defunct British brand Thomas Cook & Son, who established its first office in India and eventually extended to over 233 locations, in 94 cities across India, Sri Lanka and Mauritius. Thomas Cook India is a subsidiary of Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Limited, and its controlled affiliates which holds 67.63% of the company.
